Class ChromaticAPI

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.ChromaticAPI
public class ChromaticAPI extends Object
Registers formatting codes and gives render callbacks access to the current glyph context.

Registration methods update the shared ChromaticDefinitions registry. Context methods read or change the glyph state stored for the calling thread; another thread keeps its own values. A font identity in this API usually selects an effect and does not require a separate font texture.

Use ChromaticDefinitions when a mod or script needs to remove its registrations later. Its registration receipts can be closed; the convenience methods here do not return those receipts.

Renderers must save and restore context around nested draws, including when a callback throws. Each setter changes one field; it neither opens a rendering scope nor validates arbitrary callback data. Effect callbacks normally read this context while the renderer manages it. Coordinates use GUI pixels after Minecraft selects its interface scale.

getOutlineColorValue() reads the shared default outline color. getOutlineColor() reads this thread's current draw color. Each has its own setter.

    • registerEffect

      public static void registerEffect(char code, net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation fontId, IChromaticEffect effect)
      Registers a custom character trigger for an effect through the shared definition owner.
      Parameters:
      code - custom character, normalized to lowercase; vanilla formatting characters are reserved
      fontId - non-null effect identity; this is an identifier, not a required font resource
      effect - non-null callback object to share with readers
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the trigger is invalid, the effect is null or the final effect identity conflicts
      NullPointerException - if the identity is null

      public static void registerNamedEffect(String name, net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation fontId, IChromaticEffect effect)

      Parameters:
      name - nonblank name without brackets/control characters, at most 256 characters
      fontId - non-null effect identity, independent of actual font assets

      Throws:

      NullPointerException - if the effect identity is null

    • getByFont

      public static IChromaticEffect getByFont(net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation fontId)
      Resolves an effect identity, rebuilding a valid inline effect on demand when no registered effect matches.

      A registered effect takes precedence even if its identity has the inline prefix. The inline-enabled flag applies to the fallback resolver, not to that explicit registration. A saved inline identity keeps its encoded settings; rebuilding after a cache clear uses the current movement factory. See InlineEffects.effectFor for callback lifetime.

      Parameters:
      fontId - effect or encoded inline identity, or null
      Returns:
      registered shared effect, or an enabled valid inline effect; null when neither resolves

    • getFontForInlineCode

      public static net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation getFontForInlineCode(String name)
      Parses the content of an inline bracket token into its self-contained effect identity.

      Validation can invoke a movement factory and cache its effect. The returned identity is not a guarantee that a later lookup returns the same callback object; see InlineEffects.fontFor(String).

      Parameters:
      name - bracket content including its leading tilde, or null
      Returns:
      encoded effect identity, or null for malformed/disabled inline input

    • isInlineCode

      public static boolean isInlineCode(String name)
      Tests whether bracket content validates using the current inline-code setting.

      This delegates to InlineEffects.isValid(String) and can construct/cache an effect. For a marker-only check without validation or factory work, use InlineEffects.isInlineName(String).

      Parameters:
      name - bracket content including its leading tilde, or null
      Returns:
      true when an inline identity can be built; parsing may populate memoization caches

    • parseOutlineBracket

      public static int[] parseOutlineBracket(String name)
      Resolves a registered outline bracket name to its requested color or the configured default.

      This source-compatible helper accepts the hexadecimal suffix through Long.parseLong and falls back on numeric parse failure. The main text parser has its own stricter six-digit RGB validation; callers must not treat this helper as that stricter token validator.

      Parameters:
      name - bracket content without square brackets, or null
      Returns:
      new one-element array containing the parsed suffix cast to int, or the shared default when the suffix is absent or invalid; null if no outline name is registered

    • triggerId

      public static net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation triggerId(String kind, String trigger)
      Builds a deterministic namespaced registration identity from a trigger's UTF-8 SHA-256 digest.

      The digest lets arbitrary trigger spelling become a legal lowercase resource path. It is an identity mechanism, not an access-control boundary.

      Parameters:
      kind - path-safe category inserted under formatting/
      trigger - non-null original trigger spelling to hash
      Returns:
      identity in this mod's namespace
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if trigger is null
      IllegalStateException - if the Java runtime does not provide SHA-256

    • getSegmentStartX

      public static float getSegmentStartX()
      Reads the current run's horizontal origin in GUI pixels from the calling thread.

      The native renderer records the FontRenderer pen x before drawing the run's effect passes. Subtract this value from a supplied sample x to obtain a horizontal position relative to that run. Custom translations and scaling do not change the stored origin.

      Returns:
      this thread's segment origin in GUI pixels; initially zero
      See Also:
      • setSegmentStartX

    • setSegmentWidth

      public static void setSegmentWidth(float width)

      The caller must restore its previous value after the draw, including on exceptions.

      Parameters:
      width - nominal run width; the setter does not validate bounds

    • getSegmentWidth

      public static float getSegmentWidth()
      Reads the current run's nominal width in GUI pixels from the calling thread.

      The native renderer sums the run's glyph advances before applying whole-segment geometry. This includes layout size/spacing adjustments, but not visual expansion from breathing, flipping or another whole-segment transform.

      Returns:
      this thread's nominal segment width in GUI pixels; initially zero
      See Also:
      • setSegmentWidth

    • getGlyphIndex

      public static int getGlyphIndex()
      Reads the glyph or Matrix-column index used for repeatable sampling from the calling thread.

      The native renderer counts glyphs from zero within each run and starts that counter again for each pass. Matrix-rain background sampling uses its column index instead. The setter allows custom renderers to supply their own index; it does not derive a position from the source text.

      Returns:
      this thread's glyph or Matrix-column sampling index; initially zero
      See Also:
      • setGlyphIndex
